subject: Add heartbeat + completion notice to classifier and Stop hook
description:
Implement two features in the Zonoid orchestrator at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid: ## Feature 1: Progress heartbeat via classify.sh The classifier (hooks/classify.sh) already injects instructions into the main agent on every UserPromptSubmit. Add a heartbeat instruction: 1. In daemon.js: add `report_interval_seconds` to the overlay config defaults (default: 300). The existing `POST /config` endpoint already merges arbitrary fields — no new route needed. Add a `GET /config` route (or expose the existing config via the dashboard's data endpoint) so hooks can read it. 2. In classify.sh: after building the existing context output, read `report_interval_seconds` from `GET localhost:$PORT/config`. Adjust it based on the routing decision already computed: - decision=workflow or many in-flight tasks → multiply by 0.67 (tighten), floor at 60s - decision=solo/simple → multiply by 1.33 (relax) - Clamp to [60, 3600] Add this line to the additionalContext output: `"If tasks are in flight, use ScheduleWakeup({delaySeconds: X, reason: 'progress heartbeat', prompt: 'Report progress on in-flight orchestrator tasks: call show_dashboard, summarize what completed and what is still running, then reschedule the next heartbeat.'}) after responding."` 3. In public/graph.html settings popup (around line 260-272): add a dropdown for the heartbeat interval before the Save button: ```html
Progress heartbeat
How often the main agent auto-reports in-flight task progress
``` Wire it into toggleSettingsPopup (load saved value into dropdown) and saveSettings (save to localStorage + POST /config {report_interval_seconds: value}). ## Feature 2: Completion notice via Stop hook When a subagent finishes and the main agent responds, the Stop hook should surface what just completed. 1. In daemon.js: add a `/completed-since` endpoint. It accepts `?session=SID&since=TIMESTAMP` and returns tasks that moved to done/failed since that timestamp, with their labels and brief summaries. Also add `/completed-since/ack` (POST) that records the last-acked timestamp per session. 2. Create hooks/stop-report.sh: fires on the Stop hook event. Reads last-ack timestamp for this session from daemon, calls `/completed-since`, if any tasks completed emits additionalContext: `"[Orchestrator] Tasks completed since your last response: "`. 3. Wire stop-report.sh into .claude/settings.json Stop hook. ## Constraints - Call start_task on the task assigned to you BEFORE editing any files (gate requirement) - The daemon source is at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js - Hooks live at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/ but are symlinked from /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/hooks/ — edit the zonoid/hooks/ originals - settings.json is at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/.claude/settings.json - Match existing code style exactly - Do not restart the daemon (disruptive — user will do it)

summary: Added structured hookSpecificOutput completion notice to orch-stop.sh. When cancel/stop fires, the hook now outputs a JSON completion notice (instead of only stderr) instructing the agent to call set_status/complete_task and reschedule ScheduleWakeup before halting. Heartbeat in classify.sh was already present from the prior commit (a166a37); only the stop hook needed updating. Committed as 27718f3.
